title: the old quarter Rising
author: Quentin Whitlock
blurb: Isandro Okafor, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
